description: List a repository's reports, newest first, as summaries with their run totals. Use it to browse report history; with `select`, to follow given entities across runs.

ResourceSelect.description:
One resource of a `Select`: the entities to read, each with every
section and value the report has of it.

keys.description:
Exact, case-sensitive entity keys. Their format depends on the
resource and is given by its field of `Select`; mostly a diff row's
`key`, but io takes the value's label and keeps every operation of it.

Select.description:
`select=` as sent: per resource, exact entity keys.
Shared by the REST query and the MCP tools, whose schema it is.

http.description: HTTP call keys: `name | route | source`, `-` for a part the entry lacks.

sql.description: SQL keys: `query | route | source`, `-` for a part the entry lacks.

threads.description:
Thread keys: the thread name; keeps every thread of that name in a
payload and the diff's row summing them.

benchmark.description:
Only this benchmark's reports, by name as `list_benchmarks` prints it.
Default: every benchmark of the repository.

branch.description:
Bare branch name (`main`): reports that measured that branch's ref,
in practice its push reports; pair with `event: push` for the
baseline series. For a PR's own reports use `pr`.

commit.description: Full 40-character commit sha: reports measuring it or headed at it.

cursor.description: `next_cursor` of the previous page, with the same filters.

limit.description:
Reports per page, 1 to 50, default 20; with `select` 1 to 20,
default 10.

metadata.description:
Only reports whose user_metadata has all of these keys with exactly
these values (e.g. {"runner": "Linux-ARM64"}); up to 8 pairs. Reports
without metadata never match.

repo.description: The repository as `owner/name`, as `list_repos` prints it.

select.description: Return each report with its payload, filtered as get_report's `select`.

since.description: Uploaded at or after this time: RFC 3339, or `YYYY-MM-DD` (UTC midnight).

until.description: Uploaded before this time, same format as `since`.

name: list_reports
title: List Reports
